notes: One design system for every portal. Mirage, Charm and Omen now put a design on a card the same way, run its controls through the same code, and decide whether it has anything to show by the same rule. Each portal keeps only what is its…

Any rune on any Omen card: the Storage card can carry a Media design, the Network card a Clock. A card drawn from another rune's design appears when that rune has something to show, and its controls work (play, skip, seek, mute, levels…

Designs scale to fit Omen's cards: a design keeps its proportions, fitted and centred on a card of any ratio, instead of running off one side. The Content Designer shows Omen sizes that follow another size's layout the same way.
Every rune now starts with something on every shape: a rune with no starter of its own for a shape (Media, the controls, Shortcuts, Power...) starts as Charm's card for it, scaled into that card.
Designs on Mirage cards have working controls on the panel (never in the layout maker's preview).
